Subject: Action Required: Q3 micro-sweep — reconcile open opps with forecast cadence

Team — quick, focused sweep request for Q3 forecast hygiene. Finance has flagged a handful of late-stage deals where SF close dates and Stage do not match the conversation notes. I attached a filtered SFDC export (opps > $50k, Stage = 3/4/5) and a one-page close-plan template. Please do the following by EOD Monday (Aug 3):

- Confirm ownership and current committed close date in SF for each listed opp.
- Update Stage to the correct value or move to churned/lost if the deal is no longer active.
- Populate the close-plan template only for deals you still consider committed (expected close within 30 days).

Attachments: [Attachment: SFDC_query_export_20260730.csv (csv)], [Attachment: close-plan-template.docx (docx)]

Why this matters: Finance will finalize the Q3 booked plan on Aug 6 and we need an accurate committed cohort. Small ask — high impact. Ping me if you need a quick hand or want me to reach the AE owner directly.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — digging in now. A couple of quick notes from my side after a rapid pass of the export:

- ACME-8742 shows Stage = Negotiation (4) but notes indicate legal was paused pending procurement pricing review; close date currently 2026-08-05. I'll mark as "Commit: At Risk" until procurement confirms.
- There's an old duplicate opp for Beacon Health (ID mismatch). I'll merge and clear the stale entry.

I'll fill the close-plan for ACME-8742 and flag the pricing sheet question for CS/solutions. Attaching the updated row snapshot here.

Adding my updates — did a deeper pass on the export and split action items into two buckets in-line below.

A. Committed-with-risk (need comms or docs to keep in commit):
- ACME-8742 (owner: Ben) — procurement pricing hold. Ben: please confirm if the discount request is in writing or if it's a verbal ask; if written, we need the email chain (attach to opp).
- Lunar Labs (ID 5591) — product fit signoff on 08/01, but AE notes say "PO coming next week". Update close-date to 08/15 or move to commit if you have PO.

B. Stale / requalify:
- Beacon Health duplicate — Ben to merge.
- Old pilot opps with no activity since May — recommend moving to "Disqualified" unless AE objects.

I'll take ownership of coordinating the final merges in SF and will push a small cleanup batch on Mon morning. If anyone wants me to call a single AE to lock details, I can do that — otherwise please update your rows in the CSV by EOD Monday.

Karthik
Revenue Operations Manager
